verdict.rationale: Patch cadence for critical bugs and security fixes is a fair question for any desktop or server software, so the axis applies. The pack only shows feature-focused release posts (0.3.0, 0.3.5), with no changelog, security advisories, or patch-turnaround data. A single community remark about fast development velocity alongside an unanswered GitHub issue does not document bug- or security-patch timelines.
